A2, THE LOAD-BEARING HALF CONFIRMED WITHOUT COMPUTING ARITHMETICITY AT ALL: every field determined here is excluded from containing Q(sqrt-3) TWICE OVER, because a field containing a quadratic field has even degree over Q and a cubic cannot (2 does not divide 3), and because a real embedding sigma would make sigma(sqrt-3) a real number squaring to -3, which is impossible, and all three determined fields have a real embedding. So the relayed conclusion 'no closing carries the selecting field' is CONFIRMED where it could be checked and confirmed INDEPENDENTLY OF ARITHMETICITY: the load-bearing half of main's sentence survives and only its arithmeticity clause is false. A3, B288's LOCK: test_no_closed_filling_is_arithmetic asserts N_ARITHMETIC == 0 with the comment 'none imaginary-quadratic', and THE COMMENT CONTAINS THE BUG -- imaginary-quadraticity is the CUSPED criterion while a CLOSED filling needs the COCOMPACT one (Maclachlan-Reid 8.3.2). The test's NAME asserts something FALSE while what it actually verifies is TRUE and is the load-bearing half. A test that certifies a falsehood is worse than no test, so this is recorded as a LIVE DEFECT -- and DELIBERATELY NOT REPAIRED, because B1376 is that seat's active repair and duplicating it would be the collision this record was already bitten by at B1267.
